rule: BM25-like frozen lexical evidence over ALL original body windows; rank spans by sum IDF(qword)*tf/(tf+1.2), choose greedily within residual token budget, restore original source order; query/suffix retained, metadata capped 192 tokens; overlap32; source spans exact offsets
idf_corpus: all 10123 training-origin skills, no relevance labels
full_coverage: all dynamic-budget body windows, sequential max aggregation per skill; no individual window positive labels
determinism: IDF keys and unique query terms are lexicographically sorted; lexical sums and source-order ties are independent of Python hash randomization.
short_window_policy: Keep an entire short source window when it fits; only truncated fragments need at least 32 tokens.
